summary: Trivial __thiscall byte-field setter: copies parameter a2 into the byte field at offset 0x25 of this and returns the stored value. No guards, globals, or callees. Called by seven callers including CarCrashDamageProcessing (00496030) and LinkedListSearchWithAction (004974A0), so it serves as a shared state/flag write path.

local_names.result: return value holding the stored byte

operations.description: Copy the incoming byte parameter a2 into the local result value.
Store a2 into the byte field at offset 0x25 of this.
Return the stored byte value (result == a2).

unresolved: Semantic role of the byte field at offset 0x25 (state flag vs. mode selector) is not determinable from this function alone; it is written unconditionally and read elsewhere.
Which of the seven callers' object types own this setter is unknown; equal 0x25 offset does not imply identical class across callers.
